results.description:
HE SAVED ME FROM MY FAMILY. NOW HE WANTS EVERYTHING I HAVE LEFT.

★★★★★ "This book was darker, more emotional, and somehow even more addictive than the first. Watching Caterina transform while Marcello becomes completely obsessed with her was impossible to put down." – Reader Review

The woman who walked down the aisle in white no longer exists.

I am Caterina Rinaldi, and beneath the earth, inside a concrete bunker with no sunlight and no escape, I am learning how much of me can survive after everything I believed has been destroyed.

My family did not merely betray me.

They wanted me dead.

Now Marcello Vieri, the man I once considered my enemy, is my only protection against the bloodline that raised me.

He does not offer comfort. He offers weapons, discipline, revenge, and the promise that no one will ever make me powerless again.

Marcello is teaching me how to shoot.

How to kill.

How to become the kind of woman my father should have feared from the beginning.

Every lesson pulls me deeper into Marcello's darkness. Every command makes surrender feel less like defeat and more like safety. He wants my loyalty, my body, my trust, and every shattered piece of the soul my family tried to destroy.

His obsession should terrify me.

Instead, it is becoming the only thing holding me together.

My brother is coming to take me back.

But I am no longer waiting to be rescued.

I am waiting for revenge.

Fatal Obsession is Book 2 of 3 in The Fatal Desires Series—a dark mafia romance featuring forced proximity, protective obsession, revenge training, emotional surrender, family betrayal, violent devotion, and a heroine being transformed into a weapon by the man who refuses to lose her.
